title: blankSpace - The DeSoC of Professionals
tagline: We are trying to bridge the gap between organizations and skilled people in web3. You can think of it as a decentralized society of professionals, who can interact with each other in a decentralized manner.
description: We are trying to bridge the gap between organizations and skilled people. Basically, you can envision it as a decentralized society (DeSoC) of professionals interacting with each other. The whole idea of the project is big and we have many things on our plate. During this hackFS 2022 hackathon, we built the PoS-Arena (Proof of Skill-Arena) where organizations can host contests and quizzes and users can attempt those to check their knowledge. The user who passed the quiz would be eligible for the PoS Token issue by the quiz owner/organization.
how_its_made:
Built on top of Ethereum and smart contracts are deployed on Polygon Mumbai Testnet.  We built the PoS-Arena (Proof of Skill-Arena) where organizations can host contests and quizzes and users can attempt those to check their knowledge. The user who passed the quiz would be eligible for the PoS Token issue by the quiz owner/organization. As this token is soul-bound, it cannot be transferred or traded, only used for skill verification.
Leveraging the IPFS and web3.stroage to store and handle the data. Lit Protocol to encrypt the data before pushing it to IPFS. NFTPort API to
fetch the user's SBTs. Graph protocol to query the events, exploring ceramics DID handle user profiles.
Read the whitepaper & Roadmap here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/15tdHIoT6WHYc18UGG2sXnA_Aih7zS0M5/view?usp=sharing
